rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something light and easy to carry.

example.english: This portable radio is really light, so it’s just right to bring camping.
example.traditional: 呢部輕便收音機夠晒輕，去露營帶埋佢就啱喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 hing1 bin6 sau1 jam1 gei1 gau3 saai3 heng1 heoi3 lou6 jing4 daai3 maai4 keoi5 zau6 ngaam1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that an item is convenient to carry, rather than specifically lightweight.

example.english: This bag is portable and easy to carry onto the plane.
example.traditional: 呢個袋方便攜帶，搭飛機嗰陣拎住佢就得喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 doi6 fong1 bin6 kwai4 daai3 daap3 fei1 gei1 go2 zan6 ling1 zyu6 keoi5 zau6 dak1 laa3
